title: Create story-first play layout
implementation_brief: The UI refactor itself is bounded and milestone-aligned, but AGENTS.md requires updating automation/AGENT_REPORT.md at completion while the queued task does not permit edits under automation. Obtain approval either to add automation/AGENT_REPORT.md to the allowed scope or to waive that reporting requirement for this task. Once resolved, inspect the existing play-scene templates, styles, and tests; refactor only server-rendered markup and existing CSS so the story and current location occupy the primary responsive column, Working Toward remains visible in a quieter secondary area, and character and cultivation details use accessible collapsible presentation. Preserve all routes, forms, action names, submitted values, template context contracts, and gameplay behavior. Add or adjust only presentation-focused tests without weakening existing coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Story and current location are the primary visual focus
Character and cultivation details are accessible and collapsible
The layout remains readable and usable on mobile widths
Existing navigation, forms, actions, and gameplay behavior are unchanged
forbidden_changes: Editing files outside the queued allowed areas without human approval
Changing gameplay rules, progression, calculations, services, routes, persistence, or template context contracts
Adding dependencies, frameworks, catalogs, systems, migrations, or client-side architecture
Converting away from the existing server-rendered architecture
Deleting, skipping, weakening, or rewriting tests solely to make them pass
Performing unrelated visual or structural refactors
stop_conditions: The automation/AGENT_REPORT.md scope conflict has not been resolved by a human
The play-scene layout cannot be changed without editing Python services, routes, engine code, persistence, or other files outside the allowed areas
A requested visual behavior requires a new dependency, JavaScript framework, architecture change, or gameplay-rule decision
The existing template context or intended placement of Working Toward is ambiguous after inspecting the implementation and tests
The change would affect more than 25 files or require a broad unrelated refactor
Focused or full tests reveal failures that cannot be resolved within presentation-only scope
